name: Music Discovery
description: Search for music inside Jellyfin and discover tracks, videos, and playlists.
overview: Adds a discovery layer to Jellyfin's music library, with optional Lidarr requests and streaming companions.

versions.changelog:
- Target Jellyfin 12.1 on .NET 10.
- Intercept synthetic-video playback reports to prevent UserData foreign-key errors.
- Inject request controls into index.html only; leave JavaScript chunks untouched.
